tools.name: review_quick
tools.description: Use when you need rapid feedback on a small diff from parallel reviewers without debate. Returns compact JSON with verdict, reasoning, grouped issues, severity, confidence, file locations, and session id. repo_path: omit when the MCP server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

diff.description: Unified diff content (optional if staged=true). Leave empty only when using staged=true.

provider.description: Override LLM provider for all reviewers

model.description: Override LLM model for all reviewers

no_cache.description: Skip result caching, always run fresh

repo_path.description: Optional repo root override. Omit it when the server is already running inside the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root and keep it inside the server boundary.

output_format.description: Result format (default: compact; json returns the versioned codeagora.review.v1 agent contract)

staged.description: Review git staged changes instead of diff input

tools.name: review_full
tools.description: Use when you need the full CodeAgora review pipeline with reviewer debate and head verdict for higher-confidence decisions. Returns compact JSON with verdict, issues, confidence scores, debate-informed reasoning, and session id. repo_path: omit when the MCP server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

diff.description: Unified diff content (optional if staged=true). Leave empty only when using staged=true.

provider.description: Override LLM provider for all reviewers

model.description: Override LLM model for all reviewers

no_cache.description: Skip result caching, always run fresh

repo_path.description: Optional repo root override. Omit it when the server is already running inside the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root and keep it inside the server boundary.

output_format.description: Result format (default: compact; json returns the versioned codeagora.review.v1 agent contract)

staged.description: Review git staged changes instead of diff input

tools.name: review_pr
tools.description: Use when you need to review a GitHub pull request by URL or PR number instead of pasting a diff. Returns compact JSON review output or the requested formatted output, and can post review comments when post_review is true. repo_path: omit when the MCP server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root for git remote and gh CLI resolution.

pr_number.description: PR number (auto-detects owner/repo from git remote)

provider.description: Override LLM provider for all reviewers

model.description: Override LLM model for all reviewers

no_cache.description: Skip result caching, always run fresh

repo_path.description: Optional repo root override. Omit it when the server is already running inside the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root and keep it inside the server boundary.

output_format.description: Result format (default: compact; json returns the versioned codeagora.review.v1 agent contract)

post_review.description: Post review comments to the GitHub PR

tools.name: dry_run
tools.description: Use when you need a fast preflight for unified diff size, risk, and estimated review cost before running LLM reviewers. Returns JSON with complexity, file/line counts, security-sensitive files, and estimated cost. No repo_path: this tool only inspects the diff string passed in the request.

tools.name: explain_session
tools.description: Use when you need a human-readable walkthrough of a completed review session and its follow-up questions. Returns narrative text from saved session artifacts with no LLM calls. repo_path: omit when the MCP server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

repo_path.description: Optional repo root override for session lookup. Omit it when the server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Use when you need to compare reviewer model quality from accumulated Thompson Sampling data before choosing a model mix. Returns formatted leaderboard text with ranked model performance. No repo_path: leaderboard reads global model metrics rather than workspace session files.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Use when you need audit/reporting totals for reviews already run in a workspace. Returns formatted session statistics text. repo_path: omit when the MCP server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

repo_path.description: Optional repo root override for session stats. Omit it when the server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

tools.name: config_get
tools.description: Use when you need to inspect the active CodeAgora configuration before choosing reviewers or changing settings. Returns the full config as JSON, or one dot-notation key/value pair. repo_path: omit when the MCP server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

key.description: Dot-notation key (e.g. "discussion.maxRounds"). Omit for full config.

repo_path.description: Optional repo root override for config lookup. Omit it when you are already inside the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

tools.name: config_set
tools.description: Use when you need to update a CodeAgora setting from an MCP client without opening the config file manually. Returns JSON confirming the updated key and value after schema validation. repo_path: omit when the MCP server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.

repo_path.description: Optional repo root override for config mutation. Omit it when the server already runs in the target workspace; otherwise pass the exact workspace root.
